description: Saves a circuit design that has no blocking wiring issues and returns a link that opens it in the EasyCircuit editor, with schematic, breadboard and perfboard views, editing, and parts ordering. Anyone with the link can open a copy. Designs with blocking issues are not saved.

design.description: A complete circuit. nets: {net_id: {label, color '#rrggbb'}}. components: [{id, name, type: controller|sensor|switch|power|load|bus|protection|camera|assembly|wiring, pins: [{id, label, side: left|right, net}]}]. connections: [{id, from: 'componentId.pinId', to: 'componentId.pinId', net}]. Ids are short lowercase strings and pin labels are the part's real pin labels. The wiring checks expect every wired part's power and GND pins to be wired, a common GND, VCC, GND, SDA and SCL on I2C devices, and a battery or power-supply component for motors, pumps, solenoids and heaters.

name.description: Short project name shown in the editor.
